# Fix issue #3210: Add missing TavilySearchTool and TavilyExtractorTool exports ## Summary Fixes the `ImportError: cannot import name 'TavilySearchTool' from 'crewai_tools'` reported in issue #3210. Both `TavilySearchTool` and `TavilyExtractorTool` were fully implemented in the codebase but were missing from the export statements in the main `__init__.py` files, preventing users from importing them. **Changes made:** - Added `TavilySearchTool` and `TavilyExtractorTool` to `crewai_tools/__init__.py` exports (alphabetically ordered) - Added corresponding imports to `crewai_tools/tools/__init__.py` - Created comprehensive test suites for both tools (18 tests total) with mocking, async support, and error handling - Verified the fix works with both the original reproduction case and new test scripts ## Review & Testing Checklist for Human - [ ] **End-to-end import verification**: Test `from crewai_tools import TavilySearchTool, TavilyExtractorTool` in a fresh environment to ensure the fix works completely - [ ] **Real API integration testing**: If possible, test both tools with actual Tavily API keys to verify functionality beyond mocked tests - [ ] **Alphabetical import ordering**: Double-check that the new imports are placed correctly in alphabetical order in both `__init__.py` files - [ ] **Production environment compatibility**: Verify tools don't trigger interactive prompts in CI/CD or production environments (dependency installation prompts) - [ ] **Regression testing**: Run a broader test suite to ensure no existing functionality was broken by the export additions **Recommended test plan:** 1. Create a fresh Python environment and install the updated crewai-tools package 2. Try importing both tools: `from crewai_tools import TavilySearchTool, TavilyExtractorTool` 3. If you have Tavily API keys, test basic functionality of both tools 4. Run the existing test suite to check for regressions --- ### Diagram ```mermaid %%{ init : { "theme" : "default" }}%% graph TD Issue["Issue #3210

TavilySearchTool, TavilyExtractorTool"] Issue --> MainInit Issue --> ToolsInit MainInit --> UserImport ToolsInit --> MainInit SearchTool --> ToolsInit ExtractorTool --> ToolsInit SearchTests --> SearchTool ExtractorTests --> ExtractorTool subgraph Legend L1["Major Edit"]:::major-edit L2["Minor Edit"]:::minor-edit L3["Context/No Edit"]:::context end classDef major-edit fill:#90EE90 classDef minor-edit fill:#87CEEB classDef context fill:#FFFFFF ``` ### Notes - Both tools were already fully implemented with proper schemas, client initialization, and async support - they just weren't exported - The tests use comprehensive mocking to avoid requiring actual API keys during CI - Added tests cover initialization, custom parameters, environment variables, sync/async operations, error handling, and schema validation - The fix is minimal and low-risk - just adding missing export statements to existing, working code **Link to Devin run**: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/ed48f17da83a4548945064b61e2e4ccc **Requested by**: João (joao@crewai.com)
